main_text.l: [illegible, ~0 letters]
GENSERICVS
GENSERICVS, Alanorum, Vandalorumque Rex ab
Hispaniis euocatus à Bonifacio Africæ præfecto, in Libyam in-
tromittitur, vt eidem Bonifacio aduersus Sigisuldũ siue Suul-
dum opem ferat, nam Bonifacius ille Africa vsurpare conaba-
tur. Genfericus itaque cum suis Alanis & Vandalis tota pene
Africam ferro, flamma, rapinis crudelissimè deuastans, catholi-
cam insuper fidem Arriana impietate subuertit: anno mundi
4390. à Christo nato 428. post treis annos Hipponen obsedit:
mense 3. obsidionis D. Augustinus, in illa ipsa vrbe cuius erat
Episcopus, obiit annos natus 76. nec vrbis suæ ruinam vidit.
Pom.Læt.Paul.Diac.li.14. Ab Vrsper.
ATTILA Hunnorum Rex omniúmq; Septentrionalium
pene nationum, fratre suum occidit, eiusq; subditos sibi parere
compulit. Hic Imperium Occidentale ambiens, ac Visigothis
inuidęs, exercitum 500000. hominum comparauit: in Galliam
irrupit: cum Ætio, Imperatoris vice gerente, & cum Theodori-
co Visigothorũ Rege, in campis Catalaunicis grauissimo pr-
ælio pugnauit: cæsa sunt 180000. (alij scribunt 200000.) vtrinque
hominũ, inter quos Theodoricus: tantúmq; sanguinis effusum
est, vt paruulus qui ibi labebatur riuulus, immodicus subito
torrens effectus, cadauera secum traheret peremptorum. com-
missum est id prælium anno mundi 4414. post Christum natum
452. nullus pedè retulit, nullus retro vulnus accepit: tanta con-
tentione pugnatum est. At superatus Attila, tandémq; resipiēs,
Italiā peruasit furibundus, actúmq; effet de ea, ni Papa supplex
illum adiēs, totius Italiæ salutem reportasset. Vxorem exinde
duxit Imperatoris Valentiniani filiam, alias minitatus Impera-
tori: dein alteram duxit: cúmque nuptiarum die nimio se vino
ingurgitasset, expirauit. Pau.Diac.li.15. Ab, Vrsper.

page.notes: Two woodcut medallion portraits above the text: left labelled "GEISE[RICVS]" (around the rim, partly legible as "RICVS" and "GEI S E"), right labelled "ATTILA". Their rim inscriptions are read from the scan and may be incomplete. The first main_text element above is a stray placeholder and should be ignored; the heading GENSERICVS is the first line of the paragraph and is printed as running text in capitals at the start of the paragraph, so it is included in that paragraph rather than as a heading. Passage "Sigisuldũ" and "Vrsper" are as printed. Possible misreadings: "Hipponen", "Catalaunicis" and the numerals are copied as printed.
